subtitle: Lesson 19 · Authentication, Access Control & Cryptography Basics

code:
Symmetric encryption (AES)

Key:      [ shared-secret ]
Encrypt:  data + key -> ciphertext
Decrypt:  ciphertext + SAME key -> data

Fast. Problem: how do both sides get the same key safely?
caption: The key-exchange problem: sending the key in the open defeats the point.

code:
Asymmetric encryption (RSA)

Public key:   share with anyone
Private key:  never leaves its owner

Encrypt with public key -> only the
matching private key can decrypt
caption: No secret ever has to travel in the clear — but the math is much slower.
